title: Spot the difference: farm
prompt: Three things changed between the two farm pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The green bunch of grapes changed colour from purple to green, the red apple changed colour from yellow to red and the brown rabbit changed colour from gray to brown. Nothing else is different.
